rules.name: Unsubstantiated Claim
rules.why: Brand rule FACT-01 (Claims & Evidence) requires any 'No.1', 'Best' or similar superiority claim to have an approved, up-to-date source on file.

suggestion.text: Gujarat ka apna snacks brand, 2018 se

source.quote: Superiority claims (No.1, best, biggest, leading) must carry an approved evidence source on file.

rules.name: Tone Mismatch
rules.why: Tone rule TONE-04: Arka's voice is warm and family-first, not hype-driven. Words like 'obsessed' push a hype tone the brand book disallows.

suggestion.note: Keeps the writer's intent, stays warm without hype.

source.quote: Avoid hype wording (obsessed, addictive, insanely). Prefer warm, family-first language.

rules.name: Terminology
rules.why: Terminology rule TERM-02: the approved customer-facing term is 'plant-based'. 'Vegan-friendly' is retired wording from the 2023 guidelines.
